objective: Inventory public primary perinatal data and metadata available for the birthing suite; distinguish aggregate retrospective statistics, recorded field definitions, normative policy, and synthetic assumptions, and state the limits on inferring individual hazards.
steps: Inventory the current public national and Queensland primary data, collection metadata, and indicator metadata, recording jurisdiction, edition/version, data period, public output type, and source URL.

Classify each source as aggregate observed statistics, data/field definitions, or normative guidance; separate those from synthetic hypotheses and state whether a source supports a population distribution or an individual hazard model.

Record source-specific scope, standardisation, missingness, lag, censoring, subjectivity, and correlation/identifiability limitations. Do not download restricted records, request data, or define clinical thresholds.
Run repository planning-integrity checks and diff checks; capture source access date, exact commands, hashes, results, and limits in the evidence record.
Obtain reviewer-agent review of the exact implementation commit and remediate findings before coordinator acceptance.

verification.oracle: The task catalog remains consistent with source plans and dependency edges.
Conductor planning links and phase structure remain internally valid.
The inventory and packet have no whitespace errors.

acceptance: Official AIHW and Queensland Health sources are recorded with distinct publication/data years and versions; source records distinguish observed aggregate values from metadata and policy.
The inventory states that aggregate rates and process/outcome indicators do not identify person-level hazards or joint event distributions.

Queensland duration fields are classified as collected field definitions, with the manual's allowance for subjective clinical judgement retained; no duration distribution is inferred from field existence.
Synthetic hypotheses and evidence gaps are explicit; no clinical threshold, profile value, data request, individual-level record, or operational claim is introduced.
Reviewer-agent/subagent has reviewed the exact commit and all findings have been addressed before the coordinator marks B0.1 accepted.
stop_conditions: Official source version or data period cannot be established
A source requires restricted individual-level access to support the proposed claim
A profile value or clinical decision would have to be invented to complete the inventory
Any edit escapes the exact write paths
